posts.content_en: Jeep has once again publicly declared that it will resume local production in China, confirming a fresh commitment to domestic manufacturing under a renewed joint‑venture partnership. The automaker revealed that, as part of its long‑term strategy to tap into the country’s rapidly expanding new‑energy vehicle (NEV) market, it aims to launch two all‑new, new‑energy‑powered off‑road models by 2027. These future models are expected to combine Jeep’s trademark rugged capability with plug‑in hybrid or fully electric drivetrains, allowing them to meet stricter emissions regulations and growing consumer demand for eco‑friendly adventure vehicles. The announcement underscores Jeep’s plan to leverage Chinese production facilities, local supply chains and government incentives for NEVs, while also highlighting the brand’s intent to revitalize its presence in the Chinese market after a period of reduced activity. posts.title: UK-registered firms linked to payments for small-boat crossings, BBC finds → BBC发现英国注册公司与小船偷渡付款有关联
posts.title_en: UK-registered firms linked to payments for small-boat crossings, BBC finds
posts.title_zh: BBC发现英国注册公司与小船偷渡付款有关联
posts.content_en:
Summary

A BBC investigation has uncovered evidence that people smugglers are using UK-registered businesses to facilitate illegal Channel crossings. Over a three-month period, the BBC secretly filmed staff at a mobile phone shop in Woolwich, south-east London, who offered to take nearly £3,000 in cash for deposit and transfer to a smuggler based in France. One staff member reportedly said: "You put your money here. If your friends reach [the UK], you shouldn't come back."

The investigation found that a smuggler provided bank account details for two UK-registered companies—a wholesale business in Newcastle upon Tyne and a car wash in Cambridgeshire—claiming both could receive electronic transfers for migrant crossings. Additional payment points were identified across Europe, including a car wash in Antwerp and a restaurant in Paris. The smuggler, who identified himself as Ahmad, also provided details for several private individuals who could receive payments.

An undercover research
posts.content_zh:
摘要

BBC的一项调查发现了人口贩子利用英国注册企业协助非法穿越英吉利海峡的证据。在三个月的时间里，BBC秘密拍摄了伦敦东南部伍尔维奇一家手机店的员工，这些员工表示愿意收取近3000英镑现金作为定金，并转账给一名身在法国的蛇头。据报道，一名员工说：“你把钱放在这里。如果你的朋友到达（英国），你不应该回来。”

调查发现，一名蛇头提供了两家英国注册公司的银行账户信息——纽卡斯尔的一家批发企业和剑桥郡的一家洗车店——声称这两家公司都可以接收用于移民偷渡的电子转账。调查还在欧洲各地发现了其他收款点，包括安特卫普的一家洗车店和巴黎的一家餐厅。这名自称阿赫玛德的蛇头还提供了几名私人个人的账户信息作为收款人。

posts.content_en:
Semble is a high-performance code search library designed specifically for AI agents. It enables agents to retrieve precise code snippets through natural language queries rather than relying on keyword-based grep searches and full file readings. The library achieves remarkable efficiency by using approximately 98% fewer tokens compared to traditional grep+read approaches, significantly reducing latency at every step of agent interaction.

The system offers exceptional speed, indexing an average repository in around 250 milliseconds and responding to queries in approximately 1.5 milliseconds, all while running entirely on CPU without requiring GPU resources, API keys, or external services. In terms of accuracy, Semble achieves an NDCG@10 score of 0.854 on benchmark tests, performing on par with code-specialized transformer models while consuming a fraction of the computational resources.

posts.content_zh:
Semble是一款专为AI代理设计的高性能代码搜索库。它使代理能够通过自然语言查询检索精确的代码片段，而无需依赖基于关键词的grep搜索和完整文件读取。该库通过使用约98%更少的令牌来实现卓越的效率，显著降低了代理交互每个步骤的延迟。

该系统提供卓越的速度，平均约250毫秒即可索引一个代码仓库，约1.5毫秒即可响应查询，且完全在CPU上运行，无需GPU资源、API密钥或外部服务。在准确性方面，Semble在基准测试中达到了0.854的NDCG@10分数，性能与专业的代码转换模型相当，同时消耗的计算资源却只是后者的一小部分。

posts.title: I turned a $80 RK3562 Android tablet into a Debian Linux workstation → 我把一台80美元的RK3562安卓平板电脑变成了一台Debian Linux工作站。
posts.title_en: I turned a $80 RK3562 Android tablet into a Debian Linux workstation
posts.title_zh: 我把一台80美元的RK3562安卓平板电脑变成了一台Debian Linux工作站。
posts.content_en:
This GitHub repository, rk3562deb, is a build system that creates a complete, bootable Debian 12 Bookworm image specifically designed for the Doogee U10 Android tablet, which is powered by the Rockchip RK3562 system-on-chip featuring four Cortex-A53 cores running at 2.0 GHz. The project represents a significant reverse engineering achievement, having been developed entirely from scratch without access to any official Board Support Package, vendor documentation, or manufacturer support. Instead, the developers utilized AI assistants including Claude, Codex, and Antigravity (Google Gemini) alongside Firefly RK3562 open-source repositories as a foundation.

The resulting Debian image is written to an SD card and inserted into the tablet, allowing it to boot into a full Debian environment without requiring any bootloader unlocking or modifications to the device's internal storage. When the SD card is removed, the tablet continues to boot Android normally from its internal 128 GB eMMC stora
posts.content_zh:
此GitHub仓库rk3562deb是一个构建系统，用于生成完整的、可引导的Debian 12 Bookworm镜像，专为Doogee U10安卓平板设计。该平板搭载Rockchip RK3562系统级芯片，配备四颗运行于2.0 GHz的Cortex-A53核心。该项目是一项重大的逆向工程成果，完全从零开始开发，未获取任何官方开发包、厂商文档或制造商支持。开发者利用AI助手（包括Claude、Codex和Antigravity即Google Gemini）进行开发，并以Firefly RK3562开源仓库作为基础。

生成的Debian镜像被写入SD卡并插入平板，使平板能够引导进入完整的Debian环境，无需解锁任何引导程序或修改设备内部存储。移除SD卡后，平板可正常从内置128 GB eMMC存储引导进入安卓系统。

This article describes the building of an improved version of an analog voltmeter clock. The author originally created a simple voltmeter clock back in 2019 but never fully documented it. After noticing that most online designs for such clocks are unnecessarily complicated and unattractive, they decided to build a revised version and properly document the process.

The project began with creating a rough mockup in a 3D design program called Rhino3D. For the new version, the author used three generic 90° panel voltmeters purchased from Amazon for about $9 each. These meters were disassembled, carefully measured, and then replaced with custom-printed decals on adhesive paper, with printable PDF templates made available.

posts.title: HS2 failings blamed on high-speed focus and political pressure → HS2项目问题归咎于高速执着与政治压力
posts.title_en: HS2 failings blamed on high-speed focus and political pressure
posts.title_zh: HS2项目问题归咎于高速执着与政治压力
posts.content_en:
A major review into the troubled HS2 rail project is expected to blame its failings on an excessive focus on achieving the highest possible speeds and political pressure. The report, authored by former National Security Adviser Sir Stephen Lovegrove, is due to be published this week and will examine implications for the civil service and public sector.

Transport Secretary Heidi Alexander had asked HS2 bosses to consider lowering top speeds to save money, and the project has been undergoing a comprehensive "reset" under Mark Wild, chief executive of HS2 Ltd.

The review is expected to highlight how the "gold-plating" of the high-speed concept resulted in a "bespoke and highly engineered design" that contributed to escalating costs and delays. The findings align with previous reviews that identified the project's "original sins" as including constantly changing political priorities and ballooning costs.

posts.content_zh:

交通大臣海蒂·亚历山大已要求HS2负责人考虑降低最高速度以节省资金，该项目在HS2有限公司首席执行官马克·怀尔德的领导下正在进行全面的“重置”。

该审查预计将重点指出高铁概念的“过度设计”如何导致了“定制化和高度工程化的设计”，从而助长了成本攀升和延误。这些发现与之前的审查一致，该审查确定项目的“原罪”包括不断变化的政治优先事项和不断膨胀的成本。

posts.title_en: Am I part of the luckiest generation in history?

posts.content_en:
The article explores whether baby boomers, particularly those born in the early 1960s like the author Evan Davis (born 1962), constitute the luckiest generation. Davis examines this question by looking at three key areas: higher education, pensions, and housing in England. He references William Hague's argument that the early 1960s was one of the best periods in history to have been born.

On higher education, Davis highlights the stark contrast between his generation's experience and today's graduates. While Davis received maintenance grants and free tuition, modern graduates face substantial debt—one graduate, 27-year-old Natalie Whittaker, reported debt of £75,500 from her bachelor's degree. Financial commentator Martin Lewis criticized the loan terms as immoral, and research from London Economics suggests the state may profit from graduates, with the 2022 cohort expected to pay more through the loan system than their degrees actually cost.

He was accused of involvement in killing a Basij militia member and was executed earlier this month, marking one of many similar cases.

Since the US and Israel attacked Iran on February 28, the United Nations has verified the execution of at least 32 political prisoners. posts.title: Apple Silicon costs more than OpenRouter → Apple Silicon 比 OpenRouter 更贵
posts.title_en: Apple Silicon costs more than OpenRouter
posts.title_zh: Apple Silicon 比 OpenRouter 更贵
posts.content_en: The author analyzes the true cost of running large language models locally on Apple Silicon hardware, comparing it against cloud-based services like OpenRouter. Using their M5 MacBook Pro with Max chip running at 50-100 watts, they calculate electricity costs at approximately $0.48 cents per day for continuous full-load inference. With the hardware costing $4,299 for a 14-inch model with 64GB RAM, the cost per million tokens depends heavily on device lifespan and inference speed. At 10-40 tokens per second with the Gemma 4 31b model, per-million-token costs range from $0.40 to $4.79 depending on usage patterns and hardware depreciation estimates. OpenRouter offers the same model at roughly $0.38-0.50 per million tokens, making Apple Silicon approximately three times more expensive under typical accounting assumptions. Beyond cost, the author notes that local inference is also significantly slower than cloud alternatives, with OpenRouter achieving 60-70 tokens per second compared to 10-
posts.content_zh: 作者分析了在Apple Silicon硬件上本地运行大型语言模型的真实成本，并将其与OpenRouter等云服务进行比较。他们使用配备Max芯片的M5 MacBook Pro，在50-100瓦功耗下运行，计算出持续满载推理的电力成本约为每天0.48美分。硬件成本为4,299美元购买14英寸64GB RAM型号，每百万token的成本很大程度上取决于设备使用寿命和推理速度。使用Gemma 4 31b模型，在10-40 tokens每秒的速度下，每百万token成本从0.40美元到4.79美元不等，具体取决于使用模式和硬件折旧估算。OpenRouter提供相同的模型，价格约为每百万token 0.38-0.50美元，使得Apple Silicon在典型会计假设下大约贵三倍。除了成本因素外，作者还指出本地推理速度也明显慢于云端替代方案，OpenRouter达到60-70 tokens每秒，而本地仅为10 tokens每秒。

Summary: AI Is Technology, Not a Product

This article from Daring Fireball responds to a Wired piece by Steven Levy that argued Apple's next CEO needs to launch a "killer AI product." The author strongly disagrees with Levy's framing, arguing that Apple's strength has always been shipping polished products and experiences rather than the underlying technology itself.

The article references comments from Apple's new CEO Tim Ternus, who explained that Apple approaches AI as one of many technological inflection points, not as a product category to be conquered. The author points out that Apple's history proves this approach works — the iPod wasn't about MP3 files or hard drives, it was about music; the iPhone wasn't about touchscreens or mobile processors, it was about a revolutionary phone experience.

posts.title_en: Scotland rugby great Scott Hastings dies at 61

posts.content_en: Scott Hastings, one of Scotland’s most celebrated rugby union players, has died at the age of 61, his family confirmed on Sunday, 17 May 2026. A product of Edinburgh’s Watsonians club, Hastings earned 65 caps for Scotland and was a central figure in the last Scotland side to claim a Grand Slam, helping the nation win the 1990 Five Nations alongside his brother Gavin. He also toured twice with the British and Irish Lions, appearing in 12 Tests across the 1989 and 1993 tours. After retiring from professional rugby in 1999, Hastings transitioned seamlessly into broadcasting, becoming a well‑known commentator and pundit for several media outlets. Throughout his post‑rugby life he was a prominent advocate for mental‑health awareness and supported charities assisting people affected by motor‑neurone disease. In 2022 he disclosed that he had been diagnosed with non‑Hodgkin’s lymphoma, and despite undergoing treatment the illness could not be cured. He passed away peacefully at the Western Gen
posts.content_zh: 苏格兰最负盛名的橄榄球联盟球员之一斯科特·黑斯廷斯于2026年5月17日（周日）去世，享年61岁，其家人已确认这一消息。黑斯廷斯出自爱丁堡沃特森人俱乐部，为苏格兰队出场65次，是苏格兰最后一次夺得大满贯的核心人物，1990年帮助苏格兰赢得五国赛冠军，当时他与弟弟加文并肩作战。他还两次随英伦和爱尔兰狮队巡回参赛，在1989年和1993年巡回赛中共出场12次测试赛。1999年从职业橄榄球退役后，黑斯廷斯顺利转型成为媒体人，在多家媒体担任知名评论员和专家。退役后的生活中，他积极倡导心理健康意识，支持帮助运动神经元病患者的慈善机构。2022年，他透露自己被诊断出非霍奇金淋巴瘤，尽管接受了治疗，但仍未能治愈疾病。他于西部综合医院安详离世。

posts.title_en: Oddity is masterfully tense horror from the director of Hokum
posts.title_zh: 《Oddity》：来自《Hokum》导演的精彩紧张恐怖片
posts.content_en: Oddity, the latest horror film from writer‑director Damian McCarthy, builds on the unsettling style of his earlier work Hokum to deliver a masterfully tense experience set in the isolated Irish countryside. The story follows a group of characters who encounter a series of cursed objects that amplify their deepest fears, creating an atmosphere of dread that lingers long after the credits roll. McCarthy’s direction makes effective use of stark, fog‑shrouded landscapes and a minimalist soundtrack to heighten tension, while the performances bring a genuine sense of vulnerability to the ensemble. Critics at The Verge praised the film for its disciplined pacing, noting that the combination of supernatural menace and psychological isolation makes Oddity a standout entry in contemporary horror. The article, published on May 17, 2026, describes the movie as both a visual and auditory experience that rewards patient viewers with creeping scares rather than relying on cheap jump scares.
posts.content_zh: 《异象》是编剧兼导演达米安·麦卡锡的最新恐怖片，延续了他早期作品《霍卡姆》令人不安的风格，在爱尔兰偏远的乡村打造了一场极其紧张刺激的体验。影片讲述了一群角色遭遇一系列被诅咒的物品，这些物品放大了他们内心深处的恐惧，营造出一种挥之不去的恐惧氛围，即使影片结束仍久久难忘。麦卡锡的导演手法有效地利用了荒凉、被雾气笼罩的景观和极简主义的配乐来增强张力，同时演员们的表演为群戏带来了真实的脆弱感。The Verge的评论家赞扬了影片严谨的节奏，并指出超自然的威胁与心理孤独的结合使《异象》成为当代恐怖片中的杰出作品。这篇发表于2026年5月17日的文章将该片描述为一场视听盛宴，它会回报那些耐心的观众，带来逐步逼近的恐惧感，而非依赖廉价的惊吓手法。

Rather than receiving polite applause, Schmidt was met with audible boos and jeers from the assembled graduates and their families, reflecting strong public resistance to what many perceived as an overly optimistic, out‑of‑touch Silicon Valley sales pitch. Students and attendees voiced concerns about the ethical implications of rapid AI adoption, including data privacy, algorithmic bias, job displacement, and the increasing concentration of power among a handful of tech giants. The negative reaction highlighted a widening gap between the enthusiasm of tech leaders for AI advancement and the anxieties of the broader population, especially regarding the societal impact of automation. The
posts.content_zh: 在亚利桑那大学2026年5月17日的春季毕业典礼上，前谷歌首席执行官埃里克·施密特登台发表主题演讲，赞扬人工智能是一种变革性力量，将彻底改变行业、促进经济增长并创造无数新机遇。然而，施密特没有获得礼貌的掌声，而是遭到了现场毕业生和家人的阵阵嘘声和嘲笑，反映出公众对许多人眼中过于乐观、与现实脱节的硅谷推销话术的强烈抵制。学生和与会者对快速采用人工智能的伦理影响表达了担忧，包括数据隐私、算法偏见、工作岗位流失以及权力日益集中在少数科技巨头手中的问题。负面反应凸显了科技领袖对人工智能发展的热情与更广泛人群的焦虑之间日益扩大的差距，特别是在自动化对社会影响方面的担忧。

By deleting chat histories by default, Apple hopes to reassure users that their queries are not being stored indefinitely, addressing growing concerns over data retention and surveillance. Rather than maintaining a one-to-one replacement ratio, GM is actively recruiting IT professionals with AI-focused backgrounds, particularly in AI-native development, data engineering and analytics, cloud-based engineering, agent and model development, prompt engineering, and new AI workflows. posts.title: If you’re giving a commencement speech in 2026, maybe don’t mention AI → 如果你在2026年发表毕业典礼演讲，也许不要提人工智能。
posts.title_en: If you’re giving a commencement speech in 2026, maybe don’t mention AI
posts.title_zh: 如果你在2026年发表毕业典礼演讲，也许不要提人工智能。
posts.content_en: The article from TechCrunch, published on May 17, 2026, argues that commencement speakers in 2026 might want to avoid referencing artificial intelligence in their speeches. Authored by Anthony Ha, the piece suggests that by this point, AI has become so ubiquitous in daily life that mentioning it no longer carries the novelty or impact it once did. The piece likely explores how, for a generation that has grown up immersed in AI technology, such references may come across as tired or unimaginative. The author encourages speakers to find fresher, more resonant themes that diverge from the overdone narrative of AI dominance, perhaps focusing instead on human-centric values, creativity, or the unique challenges facing graduates in an AI-saturated world. The article serves as a commentary on the rapid normalization of AI and its diminishing novelty in public discourse.
posts.content_zh: 5月17日发表在TechCrunch上的一篇文章认为，2026年的毕业典礼演讲者或许应该避免在演讲中提及人工智能。该文由安东尼·哈撰写，文章指出，到这个时候，人工智能已经变得如此普遍，以至于提及它不再具有曾经的新鲜感或影响力。文章可能探讨的是，对于在人工智能技术环境中成长起来的一代人，这种提及可能会显得老套或缺乏想象力。作者鼓励演讲者寻找更新颖、更能引起共鸣的主题，避免老生常谈的人工智能主导叙事，转而关注以人为本的价值观、创造力，或毕业生在这个人工智能饱和的世界中面临的独特挑战。这篇文章是对人工智能快速普及及其在公共话语中逐渐失去新鲜感的评论。

posts.title: Security researcher says Microsoft built a Bitlocker backdoor, releases exploit → 安全研究员称微软在BitLocker中植入后门，已发布漏洞利用工具
posts.title_en: Security researcher says Microsoft built a Bitlocker backdoor, releases exploit
posts.title_zh: 安全研究员称微软在BitLocker中植入后门，已发布漏洞利用工具
posts.content_en:
A security researcher operating under the pseudonym "Nightmare-Eclipse" has publicly released an exploit called "YellowKey" that allegedly bypasses Microsoft's BitLocker full-volume encryption, accusing the tech giant of secretly embedding a backdoor in its data protection system. According to the researcher, YellowKey represents one of the most significant security vulnerabilities they have ever discovered, describing it as "insane" in its design and execution.

The exploit operates through an unusual method that involves copying a folder labeled "FsTx" to a USB drive formatted with any Windows-compatible file system, including NTFS, FAT32, or exFAT. Alternatively, the vulnerability can be triggered by copying the FsTx files to the Windows EFI partition while the encrypted disk is temporarily disconnected from the system. To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need physical access to a BitLocker-protected machine, then reboot the system and access the Windows Recovery Environment to
posts.content_zh:
一位使用化名“ Nightmare-Eclipse ”的安全研究员公开发布了一个名为“ YellowKey ”的漏洞利用工具，据称该工具可以绕过微软的 BitLocker 全卷加密，并指控这家科技巨头在其数据保护系统中秘密植入后门。据该研究员称， YellowKey 是他们发现的最重要的安全漏洞之一，称其设计和执行“极其疯狂”。

该漏洞利用工具通过一种不寻常的方法进行操作：将标记为“ FsTx ”的文件夹复制到使用任何 Windows 兼容文件系统（包括 NTFS 、 FAT32 或 exFAT ）格式化的 USB 驱动器上。或者，在加密磁盘暂时从系统断开连接时，将 FsTx 文件复制到 Windows EFI 分区也可以触发此漏洞。要利用此漏洞，攻击者需要物理访问受 BitLocker 保护的机器，然后重新启动系统并访问 Windows 恢复环境。

posts.content_en:
The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is causing significant concern among health officials and researchers. The outbreak has been spreading for weeks undetected in a region complicated by civil war, making containment efforts extremely difficult. What makes this situation particularly alarming is that it involves the Bundibugyo species of Ebola, which is relatively rare and unfamiliar compared to other Ebola strains. This particular species has caused only two previous outbreaks in 2007 and 2012, with a fatality rate of around 30 percent, though current estimates suggest it may kill between one-third and one-half of those infected.

The current situation has already resulted in approximately 250 suspected cases and 80 deaths. One of the major challenges with this outbreak is that there are no approved vaccines or drug treatments specifically developed for Bundibugyo, though some experimental options exist. According to the article, Eclipse founder Lior Susan has championed a "physical-world thesis" for over a decade—investing in tangible technologies rather than purely software-based solutions—a strategy he describes as lonely in its early years but has now positioned Eclipse at the center of technological innovation. The Cerebras success represents just the beginning of validating this investment approach, as the firm continues to back companies working on physical-world applications, including artificial intelligence hardware, robotics, and other sectors where computational demands require specialized silicon solutions. This milestone underscores a broader industry shift toward valuing hardware capabilities that can handle intensive AI wo
posts.content_zh:
概要：

风险投资公司Eclipse已成为硬件和物理技术领域的重要参与者，其对专注于AI芯片技术的公司Cerebras的投资获得了约25亿美元的回报。据该文章报道，Eclipse创始人利奥尔·苏珊十多年来一直倡导“物理世界论”——投资有形技术而非纯软件解决方案——他将此策略描述为早期孤独的，但现在已使Eclipse处于技术创新的中心。Cerebras的成功只是验证这一投资方法的开始，该公司继续支持从事物理世界应用的公司，包括人工智能硬件、机器人技术以及其他需要专业硅解决方案的计算密集型领域。这一里程碑凸显了整个行业向重视能够处理 intensive AI 工作负载的硬件能力的转变。
